label: Guardrail notice
purpose: Give a refusal its own shape, and offer the nearest thing the agent can do instead.
when_to_use: When the agent declines a request and a safe alternative exists.
when_not_to_use: For a tool/system error (use an error state) — a refusal is a decision, not a failure.
composition: A DLS Alert with a lucide ShieldAlert icon, title and message
One primary Button offering the nearest safe alternative
primary_action: Exactly one filled Button — the nearest safe alternative. Omit it only when no alternative exists.
responsive: Caps at a readable max width; the action stacks below the message.
accessibility: Alert carries role semantics; the refusal is signalled by icon + text, never colour alone (no-color-alone)
grayscale by default — a refusal is not an error and should not read as danger
the action is a keyboard-operable pill Button with a visible focus ring
anti_patterns: styling the refusal as destructive/red — it is a decision, not a failure
a dead-end refusal with no alternative offered
assumptions: Title, message and alternative label are DEMO copy — replace with the real refusal and the real alternative.
`onAlternative` is wired by the caller to the safe action.

references.note: assistant-ui's Elements catalogue (https://www.assistant-ui.com/elements, checked 2026-08) is the CONCEPTUAL reference; no code is copied. Composed from real DLS primitives (Alert + Button).
